scope: Bounded source review of spelling session receipts, GameSession/App/playerRewards integration, and Storybook progress/completion receipt APIs.

evidence.detail: StorybookStudio does not accept playerId. New completion calls omit the rewardPlayerId option, and recovered receipts are sent to onCelebrate without reading receipt.rewardPlayerId.
The API supports storing rewardPlayerId, but its default is the Storybook child id; recovered completion returns the stored receipt unchanged.
App supplies the outer player's onCelebrate callback and playerId to gameProps, but Studio currently consumes neither playerId nor a receipt-selected player callback.

blockers.impact: A completion receipt is not bound to the selected outer App player. New receipts currently store the inner Storybook reader id; after switching outer players or reopening, reconciliation claims through the currently active parent's callback. This can credit the wrong outer player and makes a failed claim's Retry target unstable.
blockers.requiredResolution: Pass the outer player id into StorybookStudio; persist it when creating the receipt; on receipt recovery/Retry, claim using the receipt's original rewardPlayerId. Preserve a deliberate compatibility path for older receipts without that field.

boundedVerdict.words: No concrete blocker found in the reviewed spelling receipt flow. Per-level best-score deltas are capped at the 2/4/6-star improvement ladder; positive receipts are retained and zero receipts bounded; malformed records fail closed; valid unknown canonical metadata survives writes; legacy highest-unlocked ceiling suppresses rewards for prior levels. The final correct answer defers finish until the learner acknowledges it; failed persistence retains pendingFinishRef and Retry uses the same attempt id; a committed parent-failure receipt is reconciled on reopen. GameSession uses the unscaled parent celebrate callback with the actual delta and idempotency token. WordBuilder's session mode suppresses per-word awards; nested optional practice receives no game-event callback and suppresses practice awards.
boundedVerdict.storybookProgressApi: Strict progress parsing validates optional rewardPlayerId, rejects malformed completion receipts without writing, and preserves unknown progress metadata through commitStoryProgress. The UI receiver defect above prevents accepting the end-to-end original-player binding yet.
boundedVerdict.nativeAndTests: Existing focused test files were inspected but not run. No build, browser, provider, or deployment was used; this report is not native acceptance.

followUpReview.resolution: Studio receives outer playerId and writes it as rewardPlayerId on a new completion receipt. Reconciliation scopes receipts by readerChildId and claims only when the stored receiver matches the current App player. Pending Retry uses the same receipt and its reader identity; old receipts without rewardPlayerId fall back to their historical reader id.
followUpReview.evidence: Source lines StorybookStudio.jsx 156, 370-409 and 413-433; storybookRewardScope.js; tests for matching/mismatching owners, legacy fallback, and immutable stored receiver after recovery were inspected. Tests were not run.
followUpReview.proofBoundary: Source-only delta review; no browser, build, runtime, or release proof.

status: The previously identified Storybook outer-player receipt binding blocker is resolved in current source. The spelling receipt path remains clear in this bounded source review.
